title: Work Secrets That Make You the Highest Paid Person in the Room (ex-HR)
description: They don't pay you what you're worth. They pay you what you negotiate — and there's a whole set of rules HR never puts in writing.Ex-HR here. These are the moves that actually get you paid: what to say, when to say it, and the one thing that keeps women stuck at the bottom of the salary band for years.Grab my book, Clock In: https://emilydurham.org/clock-inNew here? No-BS career advice for women who are done being polite about it. Subscribe.
